run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all states/territories; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals; plus a dedicated source-discovery sweep). Connectivity was re-tested at the start of the run: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED and a direct curl returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for EVERY external host, including a neutral control fetch to en.wikipedia.org. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, with recentRelayFailures currently empty but every external CONNECT rejected by organization policy. This is the SAME session-wide deny-by-default egress block seen on the 2026-09-30, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 runs - now five consecutive days. Per the proxy README this is an organization policy denial that must be reported, not routed around. WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and was used for a source-discovery sweep across Tier 1-3 and to surface recent opportunities. Because the spec's fidelity rule requires every tender detail to be taken from the actual notice or its documents, and no notice page could be opened or verified, NO opportunity could be confirmed - so this run records ZERO tenders rather than repeating unverified aggregator/search snippets. The source-discovery sweep surfaced five buyer-originated procurement sources not present in any prior run (Thales Australia Supplier Relations / e-ACQuisition; BAE Systems Australia Suppliers; Newcastle Airport Tenders via TenderLink; City of Darwin Procurement; Australian Red Cross Lifeblood supplier information via VendorPanel); all are recorded in discovered_sources at medium confidence with a clear note that they were surfaced via WebSearch and could NOT be fetch-verified this run due to the egress block. No tenders, deliverables, dates, contacts, or corporate opportunities were invented.
gaps: Session-wide organisation egress block (5th consecutive day): WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and direct curl returns '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for every external host, including a neutral control (en.wikipedia.org). No external website could be opened or verified.

Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW eTendering/buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders): attempted but UNREACHABLE - every notice/detail page blocked by egress policy; zero tenders could be verified.
Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel, GBEs/government-owned corporations, universities/TAFEs, public health): attempted via WebSearch only; no detail page could be fetched to verify an opportunity.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa/Jaggaer/GEP/Ivalua, RangeMe, and major-buyer portals BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Woolworths/Coles etc.): attempted via WebSearch only; all portals remain unreachable for fetch. No corporate opportunity could be verified; none invented. Login/registration-gated and invitation-only corporate RFx remain out of scope per spec.

Opportunities surfaced by WebSearch but NOT recorded as tenders (could not be fetch-verified, so treated as discovery signal only, not source-of-truth): AIFFP Support Facility REOI (closing ~16 Oct 2026, AusTender); Laos Australia Institute Phase IV RFT (closing ~1 Oct 2026, to shortlisted orgs - likely invitation-restricted); VIC Dept of Transport & Planning statewide pavement data survey EOI (closing ~19 Oct 2026); ACT Access Canberra Woden Service Centre Relocation RFT (closing ~29 Oct 2026); ACT Household Water Efficiency Upgrades RFI. These need a detail-page fetch to confirm IDs, scope, deliverables and dates before they can be recorded as tenders.
Detail/deliverables extraction: not possible for any opportunity this run because no notice or tender document could be opened.

Discovered sources this run could not be fetch-verified (URL resolution, feed/API presence, and current-opportunity confirmation all pending) due to the egress block; each is noted accordingly and should be re-checked once egress is restored.

Proxy status checked (curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status): enabled=true, selective=false, no external tender domains permitted - consistent with an allowlist that admits only infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, package registries). This is an environment/configuration issue, not a transient network error, and has now persisted for five days.
recommended_seed_additions: Thales Australia - Supplier Relations / e-ACQuisition (https://www.thalesgroup.com/en/supplier-relations) - defence prime, registration-gated e-sourcing; sibling to Hanwha/Ventia defence buyers already tracked.

BAE Systems Australia - Suppliers / Approved Supplier List (https://www.baesystems.com/en-aus/our-company/about-us/our-suppliers) - defence prime; also engages via ICN Gateway (already tracked) and Hunter Class Frigate program.

Newcastle Airport - Tenders (https://www.newcastleairport.com.au/our-future/planning-infrastructure/tenders) - airport corporation using TenderLink; complements Perth/WSI/Sydney airport sources already tracked.
City of Darwin - Procurement (https://www.darwin.nt.gov.au/business/procurement) - NT local-government buyer using TenderLink; NT council coverage was thin in the known set.

Australian Red Cross Lifeblood - Information for suppliers (https://www.lifeblood.com.au/about/information-for-suppliers) - national NFP/health buyer using VendorPanel for free, open supplier registration and tenders.

ENVIRONMENT FIX (highest priority): the daily routine cannot fulfil its core mission while the egress proxy blocks all external hosts. Allowlist the Tier 1 government tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au/buyingfor.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au/supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au), plus vendorpanel.com.au, tenderlink.com and service.ariba.com, so WebFetch can open and verify notices.
